faq: What speed score should I expect?
Scores vary by theme, apps and content. We do not promise a number. We focus on real improvements in load time on mobile and show you the before and after figures.
Will compressing images make them blurry?
No. We resize and compress to a quality that looks the same on screen, and we keep your original files untouched.
Can you remove apps that slow my store down?
We flag them and explain what each costs in speed. We only remove or replace an app after you say yes, and we test the store afterward.
How is this different from your SEO speed service?
This one is a store care check, useful at any time. The SEO version goes deeper into search-related measures such as Core Web Vitals and template code.
